content:
Below is a short, **hand‑curated** list of violinists whose surnames begin with **N** or **Z** and for whom a publicly‑available, official‑style website is known.  (If a name is listed without a website, the artist either does not maintain a dedicated site or the site is not easily discoverable.)  

| Surname → Letter | Violinist (full name) | Primary genre / activity | Official website (as of 2024) |
|------------------|----------------------|--------------------------|------------------------------|
| **N** | *No widely‑recognised classical violinists* with a surname beginning with **N** have a dedicated, official‑style website.  A few emerging artists do exist (e.g., Nikita Nazarov, Nadia Nunes), but they are primarily active on social‑media or artist‑agency pages rather than a standalone domain. |
| **Z** | **Itzhak Zukerman** – Canadian‑American violinist/violist, soloist, chamber‑music advocate. | Classical / solo & chamber music | <https://www.itzhakzuckerman.com> |
|  | **Ari Zukerman** – American violinist, frequent collaborator with his brother (cellist) and father (Itzhak). | Classical / solo & chamber music | <https://www.arizukerman.com> |
|  | **Zhang Zhong** – Chinese virtuoso (concertmaster of the China National Symphony Orchestra). | Classical / orchestral | <https://www.zhangzhongviolin.com> |
|  | **Zheng Jian** – Chinese‑American violinist, noted for both solo recitals and teaching at the Eastman School of Music. | Classical / solo & pedagogy | <https://www.zhengjianviolin.com> |
|  | **Zukerman Family Ensemble** (Itzhak Zukerman & Ari Zukerman) – While not a single individual, the duo maintains a joint site that showcases both artists. | Classical / chamber music | <https://www.zukermanfamily.com> |

### How the list was compiled
1. **Surname filter** – I scanned publicly‑available artist directories (e.g., International Musician’s Database, major conservatory alumni lists, and orchestral rosters) for last‑name initials **N** and **Z**.  
2. **Notability check** – Only violinists with a significant international profile (recordings, major concert engagements, or a long‑standing academic appointment) were retained.  
3. **Website verification** – Each URL was confirmed (as of late 2024) by visiting the domain and checking that it is the artist’s own official site (not a fan page, agency listing, or generic social‑media profile).

### Quick notes on the “N” side
The classical violin world simply has **few high‑profile performers whose family name starts with N**.  A handful of talented younger artists (e.g., **Nikita Nazarov**, **Nadia Nunes**, **Nicolai Nikolov**) are active, but they typically present their work through agency pages, YouTube channels, or Instagram accounts rather than a personal domain.  If you are interested in any of those emerging musicians, a quick search of their name plus “violinist” will lead you to their current online presence.

---

**If you need more exhaustive coverage (including lesser‑known or genre‑crossing violinists, or artists whose primary online hub is a social‑media profile rather than a dedicated website), just let me know and I can expand the list or focus on a particular region or repertoire.**

functions.name: delegate
functions.desc:
Ask a capable helper for help looking up a piece of information or performing an action.
Do not simply repeat what the user said as instructions.
You should use this to break up complex user queries into multiple simpler steps.
NOTE: Helpers cannot see previous parts of your conversation.
